summary_1line: Arjuna faces multiple Kuru champions while standards of great warriors are described, and elsewhere Drona fiercely engages the Panchalas and Yudhishthira.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna and Krishna stand on their chariot blowing Devadatta and Panchajanya while armies on every side answer with roaring conchs beneath a sky filled with banners.
Arjuna’s chariot with the great ape banner rises above the battlefield while surrounding Kuru warriors shower him with arrows from every direction.
Yudhishthira, enraged, lifts a terrible golden-shafted dart with eight ringing bells while Drona’s arrows darken the sky around him.
